summary.result: Finally, it should be considered that the assessment results might differ for the same assessment standards from assessers' different perspectives.
summary.background: The model, developed principally based on Eckes' $Q{\times}A=E$ Evaluation Model, was applied to 85 project-concerned persons which had been participated in the local industry promotion project from 2009 to 2011.
summary.method: Through the applicability test works of this model, its usefulness and importance for better implementation of the project was ascertained, especially to reflect cultural changes of project actors positively.
